questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Water moves through connected processes that affect local supplies.
options: Water moves through connected processes that affect local supplies.
All rainwater reaches rivers immediately.
Groundwater is replaced instantly after use.
Buildings never influence the movement of rainwater.
questions.explanation: Metnin genel sonucu: Water moves through connected processes that affect local supplies.

source.en: Effective planning therefore considers both visible supplies and the less obvious connections between rainfall, soil, vegetation, and underground storage.

questions.prompt:

Although water moves continuously, the amount available to a particular community can vary greatly across seasons.
options: -e rağmen; karşıtlık bildirir

fiilin geçmişte tamamlandığını tek başına gösterir
soru sormak için kullanılır
